method: Compare the /api/analyze response schema (integration_api/schemas.py:AnalyzeResponse) and the live e2e_trace.json with the shapes the React components consume (mockData.js + each component's destructuring).

notes_by_design: mockData.js has richer fake values (pressureHpa, confidence, boundingBox) that the live backend honestly returns as null/absent (no calibrated pressure/uncertainty, no localizer). Components already guard for null/undefined, so the contract stays consistent.

mockData.js 'supplementary fields' (historicalTrack, wind/pressure/confidence/sst/envWind History) that the comment calls 'not part of the official contract' ARE actually part of AnalyzeResponse and are returned by the live backend.

field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.hour vs hours: forecast entries use 'hour' from backend; components read p.hours ?? p.hour
field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.lat/lon vs latitude/longitude: backend uses lat/lon; components read p.latitude ?? p.lat
field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.windSpeedKmh vs wind_speed_kmh: backend uses windSpeedKmh; components read p.wind_speed_kmh ?? p.windSpeedKmh

honest_null_fields_the_UI_guards: forecast[].pressureHpa (null -> charts filter it out; map popup hides when falsy)
forecast[].confidence (null -> ForecastCard shows 'Awaiting data'; map popup hides)
